create_sandbox_acquire: create a sandbox environment by calling acquire with an optional thread_id and return its sandbox ID
release_sandbox: release a sandbox from active use into the warm pool so it can be reclaimed quickly without cold-start
destroy_sandbox: destroy a sandbox by stopping its container and freeing all resources
shutdown_provider: shutdown all active and warm-pool sandboxes with graceful signal handling and cleanup
get_sandbox: get a sandbox by ID and update its last activity timestamp for idle timeout tracking
